ETERNL has updated just prior to our Sale

A quick note if you are minting with ETERNL v1 in our marketplace in the upcoming sale.

ETERNL v1 has an option to SUBMIT a transaction manually in the transactions page.

DO NOT CLICK THAT MANUALLY. Our system will submit it automatically.

In some cases ETERNL v1 does not update our marketplace after signing a transaction, in which case we cannot process the order.

If you are affected we suggest updating to ETERNL v2 which just released.

@everyone 

 Node Dashboard Update! 
The Public Node Pool Dashboard is now live at:
 https://cornucopias.io/nodes/pools

Here’s what you need to know:
 Public delegation is NOT enabled yet unless you’re a node pool operator — and even then, you can only delegate your own nodes to your own pool.

 Node Awards are NOT changing with this update.

 The dashboard shows performance stats for public pools — things like speed, uptime, and success rates. This will help you decide where to delegate in the future.

 You can now:

View top-performing pools by strength
,
Filter by region, availability, and more
,
Dive into detailed stats on each pool, including graphs and descriptions
,

 If you're a pool operator, make sure your pool is set to Public and has at least 8 nodes delegated to appear on the dashboard.

  Find out all the details by checking out the CopiWiki https://copiwiki.cornucopias.io/documentation/nodes/public-pools-dashboard

 If you prefer a visual video breakdown check out this tutorial video https://youtu.be/IP9Q5_4D_EE
